annotations.title: Monitor a Wallet or Name for 30 Days

description: Start 30 days of watchlist monitoring for one wallet address (type wallet) or one person/company name (type entity): it is screened now, re-screened every 6 hours against the latest lists, and an optional HMAC-signed webhook (a public HTTPS URL) is called whenever its status changes between clear, review and alerted. Use it for ongoing monitoring after onboarding; use screen_entity or screen_wallet for a one-off check, check_watchlist_monitors to read statuses, and cancel_watchlist_monitor to stop. Each call creates a new monitor. The response contains the monitor id and, if a webhook is set, its signing secret, both shown only once: store them. Costs $0.010 USDC per successful call via x402 on Base; unpaid calls return an x402 PaymentRequired result and failed calls are not charged.

chain.description: Optional chain hint for wallets, e.g. ethereum, base, tron (informational)

label.description: Optional reference of yours, up to 100 characters, echoed in results and webhooks

value.description: The wallet address (type wallet) or person/company name (type entity), 2-256 characters

webhook_url.description: Optional public https:// URL that receives a signed POST when the status changes

name: create_watchlist_monitor

lists_as_of.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) each screening list was last updated, keyed by list (e.g. us_ofac_sdn, eu_consolidated); check it before relying on a clear result

statusMeanings.description: Meaning of clear, review and alerted

subscription.description: id (MON- + 22 characters), type, value, status clear|review|alerted, matches, createdAt, expiresAt

webhook.description: Only when webhook_url was given: url, secret (shown once), signatureHeader, signatureFormat, events

anyOf.description: Returned with isError=true when payment is needed: sign one of `accepts` with an x402 client and repeat the call with the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

accepts.description: Accepted payment options: scheme 'exact', network 'eip155:8453' (Base), USDC asset, amount in 6-decimal atomic units, payTo address

error.description: Why payment is required, or why the submitted payment was rejected

extensions.description: x402 protocol extensions (e.g. bazaar discovery metadata)

resource.description: The paid resource: url, description, mimeType

anyOf.title: x402 PaymentRequired
